w10_P4_000980: A skate-park coach is calculating a final figure, in kilojoules, for a rider: the rider's energy of motion at the bottom of the ramp, expressed in kilojoules, plus an 8 kJ bonus that the club adds for a clean landing. The rider and board together have a mass of 39 000 g. The speed at the bottom, in m/s, is found by taking the greatest common divisor of 281 and 270, multiplying it by 7, and then subtracting 3. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000983: A freight-yard planner wants the final energy figure, in kilojoules, for a model wagon after its brake test. The figure is the wagon's energy of motion, plus 18 J added by a shunting nudge, converted to kilojoules, and then reduced by 26 kJ absorbed by the brake blocks. The model wagon has a mass of 56 kg. Its speed, in m/s, is 13 more than the number of ways to choose 2 wagons from a rake of 10. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000987: A 43 kg ice-rink resurfacing cart is driven by a single electric hub motor. It is towed at a speed, in m/s, equal to 11 times the greatest common divisor of 18 and 175. As it rolls, a small spring release adds 2 J to its energy of motion. Express the cart's resulting energy of motion in kJ.
w10_P4_000988: A 19 000 g test vehicle is launched along a rail at a speed, in m/s, equal to the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 2x² is itself changing at x = 2. A booster fan adds 19 J to the vehicle's energy of motion. The lab runs 2 identical vehicles together. A downhill section then adds 30 J to the pair, and a final push adds 20 J more. What is the total energy of motion, in J, of the pair?
w10_P4_000993: A port operator wants the total force, in newtons, that its shore-side winches must supply when 2 terminals, each with 5 berths, each with 12 identical towing carts, all start moving at once. Each cart has a mass of 133 kg and is 2.2 m long. Each cart's acceleration, in m/s², is the smaller root of x² - 14x + 48 = 0. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_000995: A 101 kg drop-weight on a materials-testing machine is accelerated at a rate, in m/s², equal to the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 5x² is itself changing at x = 3. The machine's frame is 3.2 m tall. The force needed is expressed in kilonewtons, and the machine has 6 identical drop-weights acting together. A hydraulic pre-load adds 12 kN to the total, and the manufacturer then applies a factor of 10 for the fatigue rating. What is the fatigue rating, in kN?
w10_P4_001000: A rail-freight consultant is reporting a corrected energy figure, in kilojoules: it is the total energy of motion of 9 identical model wagons, expressed in kilojoules, plus 19 kJ for the locomotive's own contribution, minus 1 kJ for measurement drift. Each model wagon has a mass of 26 000 g. Each wagon's speed, in m/s, is equal to the area under the curve y = 3x² + 8x from x = 0 to x = 3. What is the corrected energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001001: An 88 kg hovercraft model is accelerated forward on a test pond at a rate, in m/s², equal to the area under the curve y = 3x² + 2x from x = 0 to x = 1. The forward force that produces this acceleration is expressed in kilonewtons. A 5 kN mooring line then pulls the model backward. The test is run with 6 identical models all tied to the same anchor. What is the net forward force, in kN, on the 6 models together, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_001002: A conveyor motor accelerates a 45 kg crate. The acceleration, in m/s², is set by taking the number of ways to choose 4 items from 6, adding 23, and then adding 28. The crate is 1.1 m wide. The force required is reported in kilonewtons. The plant runs 9 such conveyors from one power unit. What total force, in kN, must the power unit supply?
w10_P4_001003: A 125 kg elevator car is accelerated upward by a drive motor, with gravity balanced by the counterweight. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 350 and 382, multiplied by 3, and then multiplied by 8. The shaft is 60 m tall. The building has 5 identical elevators that all start together. What total force, in N, must the drives supply?
w10_P4_001011: A cycling coach is preparing a corrected energy figure, in kilojoules. It is the total energy of motion of 4 identical bikes, plus 26 J from a tailwind, converted to kilojoules, and then reduced by 1 kJ for rolling losses. Each bike has a mass of 16 kg. Each bike's speed, in m/s, is the slope of the curve y = 2x³ + 6x² at x = 2. What is the corrected energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001012: A 32 kg buoy is towed by a survey boat at a speed, in m/s, that is 5 times the smaller root of x² - 8x + 12 = 0. The survey area covers 3 km². The boat tows 11 identical buoys per pass, makes 4 passes per survey, and completes 10 surveys in a season. What is the total energy of motion, in J, of all the buoys across the season?
w10_P4_001018: A 14 000 g projectile is launched at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 2x² + 7x from x = 2 to x = 4. The barrel is 1.6 m long. The projectile's energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules, and 7 kJ is deducted for air drag over the flight. The range fires 12 shots per session and holds 2 sessions. What is the total energy, in kJ, delivered at the targets over the 2 sessions?
w10_P4_001021: A quarry is rating the total force, in kilonewtons, for its haul-truck fleet: 8 pits, each running 11 identical trucks at once. Each truck's contribution, in kilonewtons, is the force needed to accelerate its 126 000 g test dolly, less 11 N supplied by a slope assist. The dolly's acceleration, in m/s², equals the number of ways to choose 4 tyres from 6. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001022: A stadium's turf crew wants the combined force, in kilonewtons, for 3 pitches, each pushed by 12 identical rollers at once, with each pitch's total stated in kilonewtons. Each roller has a mass of 190 kg. Its acceleration, in m/s², equals the number of ways to choose 4 crew members from 8. What is the combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_001024: A 13 kg sled is fired down a lab rail at a speed, in m/s, that is 7 more than the number of ways to choose 3 sensors from 7. The rail is 6 m long. A push at the release adds 6 J to the sled's energy of motion, and a downhill section adds 19 J more. What is the sled's energy of motion, in J, at the end?
w10_P4_001029: A fleet controller wants the total force, in newtons, needed when 11 regions, each with 12 depots, each with 8 sites, each with 12 identical carts, all accelerate their carts at once. Each cart has a mass of 79 kg. The acceleration, in m/s², is the larger root of x² - 6x + 8 = 0. What total force, in N, is needed?
w10_P4_001032: A theme-park engineer is summing a figure, in kilojoules, for 4 identical model log-flume boats. Each boat's contribution is its energy of motion at the bottom of the drop, less 28 J lost to splash, expressed in kilojoules. Each model boat has a mass of 40 000 g and the flume channel is 1.5 m wide. The boat's speed at the bottom, in m/s, is the larger root of x² - 14x + 48 = 0. What is the summed figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001041: A 113 000 g cargo pod is accelerated along a launch rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 2x³ + 4x² is itself changing at x = 2. The rail's motor must also overcome 24 N of guide friction and 10 N of air drag. The motor's total force is expressed in kilonewtons, and a 28 kN safety margin is added for the rating. What is the rating, in kN?
w10_P4_001042: A dockyard foreman wants the total winch force, in newtons, for a job: the force for 6 identical pallets moving at once, plus 30 N for the winch's own drum friction. Each pallet's force is what is needed to accelerate its 178 kg mass, plus 23 N to overcome its skid friction. The pallets are 1.2 m square. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 85 and 230. What is the total winch force, in N?
w10_P4_001047: A haulage depot is reporting the total force, in newtons, for a day's work: 9 identical trucks' worth, plus 15 N for a tailgate lift, minus 6 N recovered by a ramp. Each truck's share is the force needed to accelerate its 156 kg test load, less 3 N supplied by a slope. The load's acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 3x from x = 0 to x = 3. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001048: A ballistics lab wants the net energy, in joules, delivered to a target by 10 identical shots, after 20 J is deducted for heat lost in the backstop. Each shot is a 6 000 g slug. The slug's speed, in m/s, is 26 more than the area under the curve y = 3x² + 4x from x = 0 to x = 2. The barrel is 0.9 m long. What is the net energy, in J?
w10_P4_001052: A tram engineer needs the final force rating, in kilonewtons, for a bogie: the force to accelerate a 121 000 g test carriage, less 6 N recovered by a regenerative unit, plus 26 N for coupler drag, expressed in kilonewtons. The acceleration, in m/s², is 21 more than the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 6x from x = 2 to x = 4. What is the final rating, in kN?
w10_P4_001054: A mine shift boss wants the net force, in newtons, that a cart motor actually supplies. It is the force needed to accelerate an 89 kg cart, reduced by 27 N provided by a downhill grade and by a further 23 N from a tailwind in the tunnel. The cart's acceleration, in m/s², is 7 times the smaller root of x² - 7x + 6 = 0. What net force, in N, does the motor supply?
w10_P4_001055: A lab technician reports the net force, in kilonewtons, on a group of 10 identical trolleys. Each trolley's net force is the force needed to accelerate its 27 000 g mass, less 4 N of friction, less 21 N of drag from a fan. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 26 and 275. What is the net force on the 10 trolleys, in kN?
